question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Tedious
solution:
The correct answer is **"exciting"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tedious** means not interesting or exciting.

 
 
• ** Example:** *Learning a new computer program can be a **tedious** process.*
 
 
 
• **Exciting** means causing a feeling of happiness or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example**: *It was a really **exciting** match.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of the given word **'tedious**' is **'exciting.'**
